answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, where an agent must commit capital to validate a grove of network nodes. This financial stake creates a ripple effect of disincentives, ensuring that any attempt to spawn fake identities demands a velvet cost of burning one’s own wealth. By tying identity to economic collateral rather than compute, the system forces attackers to bear the direct fiscal consequences of their malicious activity, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive.
